w10_T4_004142: In the morning the Hilltop bakery baked 41 rolls on each tray, with 3 trays in each of its 6 ovens. In the afternoon it ran the ovens again, so that by the end of the day it had baked 3 batches of that morning size in total. In the evening half of all the rolls baked that day were sent to the night market. How many rolls were sent to the night market?
w10_T4_004143: Each of the 4 rain tanks on Kwame's farm held 168 litres on Monday, and he tracks water in litres although the pump gauge reads in millilitres, a thousand of which make a litre. From every tank he drew 44 litres for the goats and then 105 litres for the vegetable beds, and all 4 tanks were used identically. Each tank stands 2 metres tall. A cracked pipe then lost 8 litres from the combined supply. An overnight shower added 43 litres across the tanks. How many litres of water do the tanks hold altogether now?
w10_T4_004149: In the morning Mia picked 109 strawberries, then 19 more after a short break and another 43 before lunch, and she divided the whole pick equally into 3 punnets. In the afternoon she ate 43 strawberries out of one punnet over half an hour. In the evening she decided that what was left in that punnet was the perfect size for a market punnet, and she planned to pack 9 punnets of that size on each of 4 market days. How many strawberries will Mia need for those 4 market days?
w10_T4_004150: The Northside gym keeps a stack of exercise mats, which held 224 mats in September. A delivery added 19 mats. Then 188 mats were lent to the primary school for its sports day. A sponsor donated 52 mats to the stack. For the regional tournament the district sent enough mats to triple the stack, and the whole stack was then divided equally among the 3 gyms hosting events, with Northside keeping one of those equal shares as its stack. How many mats are in the Northside stack now?
w10_T4_004151: In the morning Tariq earned 111 cents delivering newspapers and 55 cents for walking a neighbour's dog, and he gave half of everything he had earned to his sister. In the afternoon he earned 80 cents more washing a car. In the evening he counted what he had kept and set himself a target: keep exactly that same amount every day, 7 days a week, for 6 weeks. How many cents will Tariq have kept if he meets his target?
w10_T4_004153: In the morning Ana's taco truck sold 6 batches of 86 tacos, then 77 more before noon, and another 19 just after. In the afternoon the owners compared notes and found that Luis's truck had sold exactly the same number as Ana's truck, so the 2 trucks had matching totals so far. In the evening Ana sold 66 more tacos and Luis sold 57 more, so Ana's evening sales beat Luis's. How many tacos did the 2 trucks sell that day altogether?
w10_T4_004154: Zed keeps his cinema money in cents, though the ticket prices are posted in dollars and he knows a hundred cents make a dollar. Each ticket normally costs 103 cents, but a student discount takes 54 cents off, and Zed had saved up exactly enough to buy 5 tickets at the discounted price, which is what his pouch held. On the day, though, the group skipped the film and spent 215 cents of the pouch on popcorn instead. What remained was shared equally among the 5 friends, and Zed then found 38 cents in the lining of his coat. How many cents does Zed have now?
w10_T4_004159: The Corner Cafe tracks its coffee beans in grams, though the roaster invoices by the kilogram and the owner knows a thousand grams make a kilogram. Each bag arrives with 121 grams of beans and the roaster tops it up with 39 grams before sealing it. A box holds 4 bags plus 63 grams of loose beans in a sachet, and the cafe took delivery of 4 boxes, which made up its entire store of beans. During the week the baristas used 1723 grams from the store, and then another 345 grams for a catering order. How many grams of beans are left in the store?
w10_T4_004168: A small soap factory keeps a running count of the bars it produces. Each mould makes 154 bars, and every run uses 3 moulds; the workers also add 60 bars from a test mould and 69 hand-cut bars to each run. The factory completes 9 runs a day and ran for 7 days this week. How many bars of soap did the factory produce this week?
w10_T4_004170: In the morning Nell picked 117 cherries and ate 76 of them straight away. In the afternoon her brother Ike came back from the orchard with twice as many cherries as Nell had left, so Ike's pile was the bigger one. In the evening Ike gave half of his cherries to a neighbour, and then his grandmother handed him 22 more. How many cherries does Ike have now?
w10_T4_004180: At the Dale orchard each harvest bin held 102 kilograms of apples, and the pickers topped each bin up with 20 kilograms more before it was weighed. There were 8 bins in total. The orchard has 200 trees. The farm shop sold 616 kilograms of the apples, and 49 kilograms were found to be bruised and thrown out. A neighbour then dropped off 40 kilograms of apples from his own trees. How many kilograms of apples does the orchard have now?
w10_T4_004181: Ezra arrived at the fun fair with 74 game tokens and used 73 of them on the bumper cars. A lucky-spin machine then tripled the tokens he had left. He won 73 tokens at the ring toss and 7 more at the duck pond. How many tokens does Ezra have now?
w10_T4_004185: At a cereal factory that has run for a dozen years, Rafa fills each box with 165 grams of flakes and Tam adds 63 grams of nuts, so Rafa puts more into every box than Tam does. The boxes are packed 9 to a carton, the cartons 6 to a pallet, and the pallets 9 to a truck. The factory employs 40 workers. Today 8 full trucks left the loading dock. How many grams of cereal left the factory today?
w10_T4_004186: In the morning the nursery's mint trays each held 74 plants, and Kit pricked out 51 more plants into each tray, filling 5 trays that made up the whole stock. In the afternoon 292 plants were sold at the plant fair. In the evening Kit divided every plant left in the stock into 6 rooted cuttings, each potted up as a new plant, and a neighbour dropped off 15 potted mint plants for the stock. How many mint plants are in the stock now?
w10_T4_004188: In the morning each pump at the Redhill water station ran for 4 hours at 200 litres an hour, and then 357 litres of each pump's output went to the fire trucks, leaving each pump's daily amount. In the afternoon the manager counted 5 pumps working exactly that way. The station ran that way every day for 7 days, and by the evening of the last day 5974 litres of the week's water had been sold to a farm. How many litres of water does the station have left from the week?
w10_T4_004197: The Brasswood band books a 209-minute slot for each rehearsal, but 103 minutes of it goes on setting up and 21 minutes on a break, so only the rest is playing time. The band rehearses 4 times a week and also plays a 76-minute concert each week. The hall charges by the hour rather than the minute, so the treasurer knows sixty minutes make an hour and converts the totals later. How many minutes of playing time does the band get over 4 weeks?
w10_T4_004198: Bo delivers groceries and counts his earnings in cents, though he knows a hundred cents make a dollar and will convert when he banks it. For each delivery he receives 21 cents from Mr Pao, the shop owner, and a 59-cent tip from the customer, Mrs Ng, so Mrs Ng gives him more per delivery than Mr Pao does. Bo makes 6 deliveries an hour, works 3 hours a shift, and did 4 shifts this week. He then spent 73 cents on a snack. How many cents does Bo have left from the week?
w10_T4_004204: Uma and her twin brother were given 164 dollars by their grandparents and split it equally between the 2 of them, and Uma put her share into her savings. She then added 35 dollars she earned babysitting. Uma is 14 years old. She managed to save exactly that same amount in each of 9 months, counting the first month. Then she spent 788 dollars of her savings on a laptop. How many dollars does Uma have in her savings now?
w10_T4_004211: At dawn there were 61 ducks on the mill pond. A flock of 34 landed within half an hour, and 17 more drifted in from the river. Then 30 ducks flew off toward the marsh. Just before dusk another 42 ducks arrived. How many ducks are on the pond at dusk?
w10_T4_004218: Pam bakes 89 cookies every morning for her stall, but 42 go unsold each day and are given to the shelter, so only the rest count as sales. She kept that up for 7 days. Her friend Joe sold 67 cookies at his own stall over the same week, far fewer than Pam, and they pooled all the cookies they had sold into one tally. Each cookie sells for 3 dollars. They then split the tally equally between the 2 of them to work out how many sales each should be credited with. How many cookie sales is Joe credited with?
w10_T4_004219: A pottery class measures clay in grams, though the supplier sells it by the kilogram and the tutor reminds everyone that a thousand grams make a kilogram. The tutor opened 7 blocks of 240 grams each and shared the clay equally among 3 students. Ada, one of the students, used 137 grams of her share on a small bowl, then received 45 grams back from a classmate and 57 grams of reclaimed clay from the slop bucket. She spent half an hour wedging it. Ada plans to bring exactly that same amount of clay to each of 8 future sessions. How many grams of clay does Ada need for those 8 sessions?
w10_T4_004223: For the school party Hugo blew up 74 balloons, his sister blew up 71, and their father managed 15. The party had 9 games planned. They tied the balloons in equal bunches to the 5 tables in the hall. The next week Hugo was asked to decorate a hall with 8 tables, each with a bunch exactly the same size as those. How many balloons does Hugo need for the second hall?
w10_T4_004225: A delivery company splits its 220-kilometre daily route equally among 4 drivers, and the dispatcher logs distances in kilometres although the vans' odometers show metres, a thousand of which make a kilometre. Each driver covers a share of that route on 4 days a week. Wren, one of the drivers, kept that schedule for 8 weeks, though she was off for half a day once and caught up later. Of Wren's total for those weeks, 770 kilometres were actually driven by a substitute while her van was serviced. How many kilometres did Wren drive herself over the 8 weeks?
w10_T4_004227: In the morning Gil set out 176 pears in each crate and sold 104 from every crate before ten, and he had 3 crates like that. In the afternoon he sold 102 more pears from what was left, and his neighbour Hana added 63 pears from her own tree, which was fewer than Gil had sold that afternoon. In the evening Hana's own stall was found to have exactly the same number of pears left as Gil's, so the 2 stalls together had a combined evening count. The market ran for 6 days, and the combined evening count was the same each day. What is the total of the combined evening counts over the 6 days?
w10_T4_004229: Zara keeps a reading log in minutes, though her teacher wants the total in hours and she knows sixty minutes make an hour. On Monday she logged 88 minutes, then added 56 minutes on Tuesday, 80 minutes on Wednesday and 34 minutes on Thursday. On Friday she realised that 210 of those minutes had actually been spent watching a film, so she struck them off the log. She then logged exactly that corrected weekly amount in each of 6 weeks, including this one. How many minutes of reading does Zara's log show for the 6 weeks?
